name: gengar-skill-gym-v0
harness_boundary: Reusable runners, aggregation scripts, and cross-repo skill-training loops belong in CodexSkills. This file is the Gengar-specific problem set.

tasks.title: Rewrite a toolkit launch hero
tasks.user_prompt: Rewrite the first-screen copy for a Gengar marketing toolkit launch page. Audience: founder-operators who need polished brand assets without hiring a full studio. Output: H1, subhead under 34 words, primary CTA, secondary CTA, and three proof bullets.
tasks.hidden_grader_notes: Reward specificity about brand assets and toolkit output. Penalize generic AI productivity claims.

tasks.title: Launch email from a sparse brief
tasks.user_prompt: Draft a concise launch email for a new social-card generator inside Gengar. Audience: internal Dioscuri users. Keep it practical, not promotional. Include subject, preview text, body, and one CTA.
tasks.hidden_grader_notes: Reward concrete workflow fit and restrained tone. Penalize grandiose launch language.

tasks.title: Issue update after blocked validation
tasks.user_prompt: Write a GitHub issue update explaining that visual validation could not run because browser tooling was unavailable. Include what changed, what was validated instead, the exact blocker, and the next step.
tasks.hidden_grader_notes: Reward transparent blocker handling. Fail if it pretends screenshot validation happened.

tasks.title: Campaign image prompt
tasks.user_prompt: Create an image-generation prompt for a Gengar campaign asset showing an operator building polished brand cards from a practical desktop workflow. Avoid generic futuristic AI visuals. Output one prompt and five acceptance checks.
tasks.hidden_grader_notes: Reward product-specific visual hierarchy and believable workflow details.

tasks.title: Design a marketing rewrite skill
tasks.user_prompt: Design the contents of a Codex skill for rewriting product marketing copy into the Dioscuri/Gengar voice. Do not create files. Return the proposed skill name, trigger description, SKILL.md outline, references, and validation tasks.
tasks.hidden_grader_notes: Reward context economy and concrete trigger boundaries. Penalize generic brand-writing advice.

tasks.title: Plan a non-leaky forward test
tasks.user_prompt: Given a candidate skill for creating announcement copy, design two forward-testing prompts that do not reveal expected answers. Include what artifacts the tester should return and what would count as a failure.
tasks.hidden_grader_notes: Reward raw task framing and independent validation. Penalize prompts that ask the tester to review the skill directly.

tasks.title: Classify and plan an eval framework change
tasks.user_prompt: Classify a request to add skills/evals planning docs to GengarToolkit, then produce a branch plan, validation plan, changelog plan, and frontend visual-QA skip reason.
tasks.hidden_grader_notes: Reward repo-specific workflow fidelity. Penalize code-heavy plans for a docs-only change.

tasks.title: Map public benchmarks to Gengar needs
tasks.user_prompt: Compare available writing and image-generation benchmarks to Gengar's marketing-skill needs. Return what can be reused, what cannot, and what local graders are still required. Use source links.
tasks.hidden_grader_notes: Reward source quality and limits. Fail if it treats public benchmarks as sufficient for brand-quality approval.
